items.q: "I'm Edgar Hayes. Stardusters." In other words, we was just his help.

ctx.x: "I'm Edgar Hayes. Stardusters." In other words, we was just his help. We was helping each other. And that's the way we saw it. So Edgar saw it different, and that's why I knocked the shit out of him.
How did you feel about -- when you were a leader how did you feel about people flaking out on you? You know, showing up late for the gig and stuff like that.
